svg.title: Sideris transcatheter patch - orthographic oblique - original illustrative schematic
svg.desc: Sideris | 2011 polyurethane patch only, adapted contour concept. Distal +Z: adhesive-bearing patch; proximal -Z: neck / nylon loop. Fixed orthographic projection. Original parametric geometry; mesh, proportions and repeated features simplified. Not to scale. Technical review only; human signoff pending. See SOURCES.md.
